description: Fire hydrants is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This set of punctual data shows fire hydrants on the island of Montreal. These bollards are high devices located along streets, equipped with a water outlet supplied from the water pipes, to which the fire-fighting hoses are connected in order to ensure fire protection. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Aqueduct, Fountain terminal, Fire hydrant, Water, Drinking water. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB/GDB, HTML, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
